guidance: At Act2 floor18 MAP, Ironclad has 85/85 HP, 142 gold, Pumpkin Candle stack5 (+1 starting energy while lit), Pyre, recurring Hatchet, upgraded Uppercut, Dominate/Vicious, and Heart of Iron potion. Choose row1/col2 Monster, which leads to early Unknown rooms and Shop. In combat inspect actual enemy intents and powers; exploit the extra energy for efficient damage and block, play Pyre only when its setup cost is justified, use Weak2 from Uppercut on dangerous attacks, and use Heart of Iron if it meaningfully prevents HP loss. Watch for retained status/self-damage before end turn. Select the actual reward for deck fit; avoid low-impact bloat. Stop at floor19 MAP or danger HP≤40.
